name: SBFC Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, SBFC Finance Limited is a systemically important, NBFC (NBFC-ND-SI) offering Secured MSME Loans and Loans against Gold[1]
keyPoints:
Leading MSME Company[1]
Among MSME-focused companies, SBFC Finance has one of the highest Assets Under Management (AUM) growth rates in the industry. The company has achieved a CAGR growth of 46% in AUM from FY19 to H1 FY25.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 57.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.42 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 10.9% over last 3 years.
